user.description: Choose the LED panel to add, or enter its address by hand.

manual.description: Enter the panel's Bluetooth address (for example AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF). You find it in Settings - Bluetooth - Advertisement monitor.

abort.already_configured: This panel is already set up.

error.invalid_address: That is not a valid Bluetooth address (format AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF).

show_text.name: Show text
show_text.description: Show centred text on the panel. Use a new line for more lines (up to 5 at scale 1).

text.name: Text
text.description: Text to show. New lines start a new row.

line_colors.name: Line colours
line_colors.description: Optional colour per line, for example [[255,160,0],[0,200,255]].

scale.name: Size
scale.description: 1 = small (8 characters per line), 2 = large (4 per line).

panel.name: Panel
panel.description: Panel name or address. Only needed with more than one panel.

fill.name: Fill colour
fill.description: Fill the whole panel with one colour.

panel.name: Panel
panel.description: Panel name or address. Only needed with more than one panel.

show_image.name: Show image
show_image.description: Show a picture file (PNG, JPG, GIF first frame) scaled to the panel.

path.name: File
path.description: Path to the picture, for example /config/www/panel/ghost.png.

fit.name: Fit
fit.description: contain = whole picture, cover = fill and crop, stretch = distort to fit.

panel.name: Panel
panel.description: Panel name or address. Only needed with more than one panel.

panel.name: Panel
panel.description: Panel name or address. Only needed with more than one panel.

show_icon.name: Show picture
show_icon.description: Show a built-in 32x32 picture: a weather state (use the state of a weather entity), moon (today's phase), season (today's season) or autumn/winter/spring/summer. Rain, snow and falling leaves can be animated.

icon.name: Picture
icon.description: Weather state (sunny, rainy, ...), moon, season, autumn, winter, spring, summer, smog or heating.

caption.name: Caption
caption.description: Short text under the picture, e.g. 12°C. Moon shows its phase name when left empty.

duration.name: Show for
duration.description: Seconds to keep the picture (the action waits this long). Rain, snow and falling leaves move meanwhile. 0 = just send it.

panel.name: Panel
panel.description: Panel name or address. Only needed with more than one panel.

frame_interval.name: Frame interval
frame_interval.description: Seconds between animation frames. The panel needs time to show each frame; too fast makes it lag behind. 0 = still picture.

language.name: Language
language.description: Language of automatic captions (moon phase, charging): en or pl. Default: Home Assistant's language.

show_clock.name: Show clock
show_clock.description: Clock face: large HH:MM, two small lines below and an optional level bar (e.g. PM2.5).

time.name: Time
time.description: Text for the big digits, e.g. 17:36. Default: current time.

bar_value.name: Bar value
bar_value.description: Value for the bar at the bottom (green to red). Empty = no bar.

bar_max.name: Bar maximum
bar_max.description: Value that fills the whole bar (default 75).

panel.name: Panel
panel.description: Panel name or address. Only needed with more than one panel.

style.name: Style
style.description: classic = large digits; flip = split-flap cards like an old flip clock.

animate.name: Animate flip
animate.description: Flip style: play the card flip when the time changes.

tint.name: Tint
tint.description: Show the whole clock in one colour, e.g. red at night. Empty = normal colours.

show_nearest_aircraft.name: Show nearest aircraft
show_nearest_aircraft.description: Read ADS-B data (aircraft.json from readsb, dump1090 or tar1090) and show the closest plane: silhouette in its direction of flight, callsign/type, altitude and distance. Returns the plane's data; nothing is shown if no plane is in range.

max_distance.name: Maximum distance
max_distance.description: Ignore planes further away than this (km).

latitude.name: Latitude
latitude.description: Your position. Default: the home location in Home Assistant.

longitude.name: Longitude
longitude.description: Your position. Default: the home location in Home Assistant.

panel.name: Panel
panel.description: Panel name or address. Only needed with more than one panel.

frame_interval.name: Frame interval
frame_interval.description: Seconds between animation frames. The panel needs time to show each frame; too fast makes it lag behind. 0 = still picture.

show_aurora.name: Show aurora forecast
show_aurora.description: NOAA geomagnetic (Kp) forecast for the next 24 hours: moving aurora, bars per 3 hours, peak and its time. Returns the forecast; draws only when the peak reaches the minimum Kp.

url.name: Forecast URL
url.description: NOAA SWPC Kp forecast JSON (default is fine).

min_kp.name: Minimum Kp
min_kp.description: Only show the picture if the forecast peak reaches this Kp (0 = always).

tint.name: Tint
tint.description: Show in one colour, e.g. red at night.

panel.name: Panel
panel.description: Panel name or address. Only needed with more than one panel.

show.name: Show on panel
show.description: Off = only return the forecast (for sensors and automations), draw nothing.
